**What happened and what did you expect?**

**Steps to reproduce**

**Environment:** OS and architecture, Fiji version, Java version, AtlasAlign Lite version.

**Workflow:** single section/batch, manual/DeepSlice, source format and dimensions.

**Evidence:** error text and a non-sensitive screenshot or synthetic reproducer.
Do not attach private laboratory data or runtime/model caches.
